1_logo_zone.size: approximately 200×27px equivalent, scaled to ~60mm wide on A3
1_logo_zone.note: logo text is horizontal, wide aspect ratio — place in top-right with padding

2_emotional_headline.text: 痛了很久，卻查不出原因？

3_subheadline.text:
熱敷、電療、按摩都試過了
好個幾天又復發
問題可能藏在深層肌肉裡

4_hero_visual.size: occupies ~45% of poster width, ~50% of height
4_hero_visual.content: stylized cross-section illustration of deep muscle layer with a fine needle targeting a glowing trigger point, electrical energy lines radiating outward, anatomical but modern medical illustration style
4_hero_visual.color_tones: deep blue background fading to light blue, warm white glow at trigger point

5_treatment_section.position: center, overlapping hero visual or below subheadline

6_body_explanation.text:
傳統治療作用於表面，難以觸及深層激痛點
絕緣針尖將電流 100% 集中於病灶
精準打破「能量危機」惡性循環

7_cta_section.layout: horizontal — QR code left, text right

cta_text.secondary: 了解完整 NEIMS 治療說明

typography.font_family: Noto Sans TC or equivalent clean sans-serif with Traditional Chinese support
typography.language: Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) primary, English accent text secondary
typography.weight_hierarchy: bold for headlines, regular for body, light for English subtitle

style_guide.visual_style: modern medical illustration meets clean healthcare design
style_guide.emotional_flow: relatable pain → cause revealed → precise solution → clear action
style_guide.avoid: orange accents (not in brand), cartoonish style, stock photo aesthetic, cluttered layout

image_generation_settings.style_keywords: medical illustration, modern healthcare poster, clean sans-serif typography, deep blue palette, Traditional Chinese text, clinical authority, print-ready
image_generation_settings.avoid_keywords: orange, decorative serif, blur, low contrast, dark background overall
